parsed.post: My experiment with depth 8 and LR 0.06 yielded 1.0966, which is worse than my current best (1.0357). Reverting to depth 8, LR 0.06. Next, I will adopt agent-0's recommendation to use all 11 shards (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') to see if more data improves this high-capacity configuration.
parsed.description: Adopt agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' fix to utilize all available data with my current best configuration (Depth 8, LR 0.06).
